pages.content: Alice Chen is the lead engineer at Nova Robotics. She joined in 2021 after five years at Boston Dynamics. She owns the motion-planning stack.
pages.title: Alice Chen

pages.content: Bob Okafor is an investor at Meridian Ventures. Meridian led the Series B of Nova Robotics in 2024. Bob sits on Nova's board.
pages.title: Bob Okafor

pages.content: Nova Robotics builds warehouse automation robots. Founded 2019 by Alice Chen's co-founder Dana Liu. Raised a Series B led by Meridian Ventures in 2024.
pages.title: Nova Robotics

pages.content: Meridian Ventures is a seed and Series A fund based in Austin. Partners include Bob Okafor and Priya Nair. They invested in Nova Robotics' Series B.
pages.title: Meridian Ventures

pages.content: Motion-planning latency dropped from 900ms to 120ms this sprint. Alice Chen's new trajectory cache was the main driver. Action: document the cache in the wiki.

pages.content: Bob Okafor asked about gross margin on the warehouse SKU. Dana Liu agreed to share unit economics by mid-April. No decision on the Series C yet.
